modes.name: Memory of Chaos
modes.buff: At the beginning of each Cycle, randomly causes an ally target following the Path of The Hunt or the Path of Erudition to take action immediately, and increases their DMG dealt by 80% for 1 turn(s).

bosses.name: Flame Reaver of the Deepest Dark

modes.name: Pure Fiction
modes.buff: After ally targets use a Follow-Up ATK to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 8 Grit Value for allies.

buffs.name: Concordant Truce
buffs.description: After an ally target uses a Follow-Up ATK or Ultimate, deals Additional DMG equal to 80% of the attacking character's ATK plus 40% of their Max HP to each attacked enemy target.

buffs.name: Surging Grit
buffs.description: Upon entering Surging Grit, all allies regenerate 20% Energy. During Surging Grit, enemy targets take 50% more DMG, the Additional DMG dealt by "Concordant Truce" increases by 100%, and this DMG is considered as Follow-Up ATK DMG.

selectableBuffs.name: Smack Talk
selectableBuffs.description: Increases the All-Type RES PEN of Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by 30%. During Surging Grit, after an ally target uses a Follow-Up ATK to attack enemy targets, deals Additional DMG equal to 40% of the attacker's ATK plus 20% of the attacker's Max HP to targets adjacent to each attacked enemy target. This DMG is considered as Follow-Up ATK DMG.

selectableBuffs.name: Grand Rhetoric
selectableBuffs.description: During Surging Grit, CRIT DMG dealt by ally targets when using their Ultimate increases by 60%. When Surging Grit ends, all allies regenerate 20% Energy. After ally targets use their Ultimate, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 5 Grit Value for allies.

selectableBuffs.name: Motormouth
selectableBuffs.description: Increases the SPD of all allies by 20%. During Surging Grit, DMG received by enemy targets additionally increases by 30%. After ally targets use their Basic ATK or Skill, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

modes.name: Apocalyptic Shadow
modes.buff: When an enemy with "Steadfast Safeguard" is Weakness Broken, dispels control states for all allies, recovers their Skill Points, and activates their Ultimates. Increases the Skill DMG taken by all enemies by 25% and increases Ultimate DMG taken by 15%.

traits.name: Steadfast Safeguard
traits.description: Boss Mirage takes 50% less DMG. After Weakness is Broken, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by 100%.

traits.name: Bountiful Prosperity
traits.description: When the Boss Mirage's summons are defeated, it deals minor True DMG to this unit and slightly reduces its Toughness. If the defeated target is an Elite Enemy, it instead deals massive True DMG to this unit and massively reduces its Toughness. Then, it immediately summons new summons.

traits.name: Like a Deer With Wings
traits.description: The initial action value of the summons summoned via "Heavenbound One And All" and "Heavenbound One And All: Enhanced" is greatly advanced.

traits.name: Dazzling Halo
traits.description: While any type of "Halo" effect is active, all enemy targets that are not Weakness Broken take reduced DMG and deal increased DMG.

axiomBuffs.name: Land of Fertility
axiomBuffs.description: Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 30%, and additionally increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by the 1st character in the lineup by 30%.

axiomBuffs.name: Unstoppable Force
axiomBuffs.description: DMG dealt by memosprites ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

axiomBuffs.name: Beaming Bliss
axiomBuffs.description: Increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 30%. When there is a character following the Path of Elation on the team, increases the Weakness Break Efficiency of all allies by 50%.

traits.name: Steadfast Safeguard
traits.description: Boss Mirage takes 50% less DMG. After its Weakness is broken, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by 100%.

traits.name: Steelbone Summit
traits.description: Parts take 50% less DMG. After Boss Mirage's Weakness is broken, the DMG they receive increases by 100%.

traits.name: Beastly Rage
traits.description: The duration of "Malediction" state increases by 1 turn(s).

axiomBuffs.name: Literary Brilliance
axiomBuffs.description: Decreases the Wind RES and Lightning RES of all enemies by 40%.

axiomBuffs.name: Past Life: Shadowed Reverie
axiomBuffs.description: When there are 3 ally memosprites or more currently on the field, increases all allies' DMG dealt by 60%.

axiomBuffs.name: Blighted to the Bone
axiomBuffs.description: After an ally target deals DoT to an enemy, 1 Energy is regenerated. DoT dealt by all allies ignores 40% of enemy targets' All-Type RES.

traits.name: Steadfast Safeguard
traits.description: Boss Mirage takes 50% less DMG. After Weakness is broken, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by 100%.

traits.name: Biphasic Battlefield
traits.description: The Boss Mirage will initiate a Live Showdown during combat, selecting one ally character to battle on the sub-field while the remaining characters stay on the prime-field to provide Support. Once the Live Showdown begins, enemy targets on the prime-field take reduced DMG and become immune to Crowd Control debuffs, and the Boss Mirage enters the "Toughness Lock" state. When the Boss Mirage's turn starts, both "Ally Popularity" and "Enemy Popularity" reset to their initial states.

traits.name: Popularity Burst
traits.description: Increases the max "Ally Popularity" and "Enemy Popularity."

traits.name: Basking in Popularity
traits.description: For each "Ally Popularity" or "Enemy Popularity" that hasn't hit the Limit, DMG taken by all enemies is reduced.

axiomBuffs.name: Beaming Bliss
axiomBuffs.description: Increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 30%. When there is a character following the Path of Elation on the team, increases the Weakness Break Efficiency of all allies by 50%.

axiomBuffs.name: Unto Apotheosis
axiomBuffs.description: When ally targets consume Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 10 times.

axiomBuffs.name: Armed Up
axiomBuffs.description: Increases Physical DMG dealt by all allies by 50%, and decreases all enemies' Physical RES by 20%.

selectableBuffs.name: Marvelous Laughter
selectableBuffs.description: Increases all ally targets' Elation by 40%, and increases the All-Type RES Pen of Elation DMG dealt by 20%. This effect is doubled when using an Elation Skill.

selectableBuffs.name: Finale's Kiss
selectableBuffs.description: At the start of any ally's target's turn, all ally targets regenerate 25% Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle. Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all ally targets by 40%.

selectableBuffs.name: Memoria Swarm
selectableBuffs.description: When the number of ally memosprites is 1/2/3/4, DMG dealt by all allies increases by 20%/25%/30%/50%.

bosses.name: Flame Reaver of the Deepest Dark
